notes.title: Meet Tarja
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/3083aa03a26b30d55ee1a0141b0958ed1191e94a.png[/img]

Hello Shield Maidens and Vikings,
 
It is time to meet another character who can have a big impact on your adventure on Steineyjar Islands.
 
In Viking culture, the unseen world was regarded as woven into everyday life. For them, this meant that gods, spirits and their ancestors could shape their fate and fortune. The outcome could be manipulated by other forces, though.
Central to this were practitioners like the Völva (a kind of seeress), who sometimes travels from village to village, carries a staff and speaks in cryptic verses - not to mention that a Völva is proficient in magic. But not just any magic. The so-called seiðr can involve trances, future prophecies, weather influence or talking to spirits.
For some cultures, this seemed like witchcraft, but for Vikings, this was a living tradition that was able to connect the community to the supernatural.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/d33ac5eac3bf95943108d5c3f115409a2a0b7e0a.jpg[/img]
 
One Völva you’ll meet on your journey is Tarja. Don’t mistake her quiet and distanced demeanor as harmless. Believe us, when we say that you really do not want to cross her or get on her bad side. If you are able to gain her loyalty you will have a truly powerful ally by your side.
 
Consulting a Völva before a long voyage, raid or major decision was common, for only a seeress was able to gain insight into hidden dangers or future success. If necessary with the help of runic magic, which also played a big part in Viking mysticism. Runes were more than simple letters. They were symbols of hidden power, giving the amulet, sword or whatever item they were inscribed to a special meaning, thus being able for example to protect or empower warriors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/25bfa07cf418e6c66527e7c574655a5b30597b57.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/b20b9b0eecce7ed5e6438cb450a24fe93617efa8.png[/img]
 
Tarja will help you make sense of the unseen in a world where the physical and spiritual realms are intertwined. A world we cannot wait to show you more of.
 
Skål!

notes.title: That’s a big one!
notes.content:
Hello Shield Maidens and Vikings

While some think of Vikings mostly as explorers and fierce warriors, they were equally skilled seafarers and fishermen, making them masters of the seas and oceans. As a society naturally bonded to the sea, fishing and seafaring were not just practical necessities. They are vital aspects of Viking culture, economy, and identity, as you will find out once you start your journey in the Steineyjar Archipelago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/5c8ff6d74037a7c9a925183d15b0b8f3c4f53223.jpg[/img]

The advanced shipbuilding techniques, which you eventually also will have access to, allowed them to build boats able to travel vast distances. The longships with their sturdy designs were not only used for raids, but also for peaceful trade.

Fishing was equally important, since in Scandinavia’s unforgiving, harsh climate, it provided a reliable and sustainable food source. Salmon, herring, and cod were among the staples in their diet and could be preserved for the long winters through drying and salting.

Coastal communities like the ones you’ll encounter and build for yourself in Vikings Dynasty depended on fishing for survival. It became embedded in their way of life, up to the point where it could influence beliefs and rituals

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/c512cd94e34c41d023e05691b2beefbdbb050f1f.jpg[/img]

The sea also held spiritual significance. A good example for this is the sea serpent Jörmungandr (aka “The Midgard Serpent”), reflecting Vikings’ respect and fear of the ocean. Experiencing the sea as both a provider and a dangerous force, a lot of them carried talismans for protection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/7fe80c6d7c28fe07558b8f701db4e2532af73c4d.png[/img]

Once you step into the world of Vikings Dynasty and start exploring, you will start to respect the sea as well. We cannot wait to show you!

Skål!
Digital Daredevils and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Being A Jarl
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/140939f56929ca6d36891125d2c63dc3f32fdb07.png[/img]

Hello shield maidens and Vikings!
 
Last time we spoke to you, we introduced you to Freydis, the jarl of the harbor town of Kaldaborg in the fictitious Steineyjar Islands.
 
But what does a jarl actually do?
In a nutshell, a jarl is a leader, whose job is governing a territory, maintaining order, and ensuring the prosperity and safety of the people.
 
The main responsibility of the jarl is governing. Think of it as a mixture of mayor and judge. The jarl enforces the common laws, settles disputes, and presides over local assemblies in order to maintain harmony among the citizens, which is crucial for stability and the general welfare of all. By taking care of the people and their needs, the jarl can secure their loyalty. Needs like safety and prosperity have a high priority, as you can imagine. Which in return means, the jarl has to make sure that the village is protected - also so trade can commence, which usually is also controlled by the jarl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/996d0bcca81d1d0bc58b62339d35ecfd9390a0d8.jpg[/img]
 
And like we mentioned the last time already, although this role was mainly portrayed by male Vikings in sagas, there were many inspiring and powerful women in Viking history, which we'd like to pay tribute to with Freydis in our game as a prime example.
 
But women in Viking society held a variety of roles, from managing the household to religious practices, from being involved in trade and craftsmanship to being a fierce warrior as a shield maiden. All of which you will be able to see and experience once you enter Steineyjar Islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/ac25354acf1e6aadc854ad9451fab70372da8b57.jpg[/img]
 
And you as a player can not only choose between a male or female character to start your journey in the world of Vikings Dynasty and eventually even strive to become a jarl, thus taking care of your villagers’ needs or try to defend them by actively searching out bandit camps and destroying them. You will learn the tools of the trade, start crafting your own tools, weapons, and even build ships and take them to see to explore the archipelago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/8709d4d44b036f14642c30c853333d39bc26c869.jpg[/img]
 
We cannot wait to see where your journey in our world will take you!
 
Until then!
 
Skål!
Digital Daredevils and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Meet Freydis
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/e3ee78fdb128bfb8393089fee8655dfa240b1f52.png[/img]

Hej shield maidens and Vikings,

A few weeks back we introduced Snorri to you, the resident skald in the world of Vikings Dynasty.
 
Today we want you to meet yet another important character on the Steineyjar Islands: Freydis, the female jarl of the archipelago.
She will play a vital role in the personal journey of your hero or heroine and will also have the occasional quest waiting for you.
 
When you eventually meet her, stay humble and pay your respect, for in the storm-lashed Steineyjar archipelago, where only the strongest will survive, she stands as a legend. A fierce warrior, a determined sailor and the current jarl of the port village of Kaldaborg.
That she undisputedly is holding a position usually reserved for male leaders, should tell you more than enough about her resilience and unbreakable spirit.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/ef230a7df977c46e957ef6a5f445c4df6965380a.jpg[/img]
 
She is a seasoned traveller, journeying with her brother in her youth, before fate struck and she was left to carve her own destiny, eventually leading her to Steineyjar Islands. Her story is one of triumph and tragedy, her life is shaped by the sea and a burning desire to prove to the gods that she is unbreakable.
 
Her leadership is pragmatic, based on experience and knowledge, not on superstition. She wields power not only through might but also through her innate ability to navigate the emotional and political challenges of the position she is holding.
This way she symbolizes the duality of Viking heroines: Revered yet feared. Uncompromising, yet human.
 
She is a jarl not only because she is strong or determined, but because she persevered. In a world where only the ruthless survive, she stands as a testament for what it means to rise, even when thunderous waves try to drag you under.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/98b29bc4966effe4a3ceee3edddfb3442dab87a4.jpg[/img]
 
The inspiration for her character is as multi-faceted as her traits and role in the game. You might notice characteristics from other important female figures in Viking culture, although we tried to put our own spin on her as much as on all characters and make her really unique, while bending the perception of the role of females in Viking society. But we will talk about that in detail soon enough.
 
Until then!
 
Skål!
 
Digital Daredevils and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: In his own words
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/b26b5dc09ad44638d58a38747b369a73dfd15bb4.png[/img]

Hello Shield Maidens and Vikings,
 
the last time we spoke we introduced our resident skald Snorri to you, one of the many memorable characters you will meet on your journey in the Steynajar archipelago.
 
We recently uncovered a collection of Snorri's poems and songs, where he talks about a variety of topics from love and life to death and heroism.
 
We definitely want to share a few of those with you over time and start today with this little piece, which is loosely inspired by Sonatorrek and the Arinbjarnarkviða.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/c3e99f9a419d20c9cf849db184ccc09e7c39a411.jpg[/img]

[i]Much does it task me
My tongue to cast
The breath of song.
Poetry, the gift of Odin,
Promise now, I may not,
A draught drawn not lightly
From deep thought's dwelling.
 
They, who so blameless
Bore the powers in life,
Adored by mountains
Beloved by the sea waters.
Unimaginable love 
Sea-waves flood that whilom
Welled from the heart's wound
Smite upon the rocky shore.
 
Remembering now the land
Draw near to their beginning,
Each stone and shore 
Praise brave Skadi and great Njord.
But no one is cheerful or gladsome
Who beareth
Body of a kinsman
On a funeral bier.
 
Of friends fallen
This isles may tell,
Of much-loved 
Who must mourn the loss.
About great adventures 
Praised in skald poetry,
And about the tree to bloom leafy
With words of Snorri's song.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/9ffc3f5ff9947f4716beddb59d1a61487efc6620.jpg[/img]
 
Until next time,
Skål

notes.title: Meet Snorri
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/86bf3b6095a98bb006f35c3d05c3b2c770f45272.png[/img]

Hello shield maidens and vikings!

Today we want to introduce the resident skald in Vikings Dynasty to you.

Meet Snorri.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/933a179f4f2bb74590caec9ac5720c8fbe85b4d3.jpg[/img]

He is one of the first characters you’ll meet on your journey through the Steynajar archipelago.

Snorri’s quests will introduce you to exploration as well as all the important features of Viking life like hunting, fishing, swimming and the deeply rooted need for courage as well as caring for your loved ones.

He might also offer you advice on setting up your first village, once you have earned the right to do so.

In the tradition of great skalds, he is not only a poet and great musician, but also a storyteller and entertainer. And he won’t shy away from commenting on your actions with his signature sense of humour.

Some might say, he would give Dandelion a run for his money when it comes to tongue-in-cheek quips.

Skalds were highly respected figures, often attached to chieftains or kings, where they composed and recited poetry praising their patrons' deeds, lineage, and battles. Before the Norse tradition was passed down in written form, they were basically the only form of history keepers.

Some noteworthy skalds you might have heard of, are Bragi Boddason (early 9th century), Gunnlaugr Ormstunga (late 10th century), who earned himself the nickname “Wormtongue” because of his satirical content (something that Snorri will also show in spades) or his namesake Snorri Sturloson, who historians say is responsible for authoring and compiling the Edda, described as the most detailed source for what we know about Norse mythology.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/efecc3b7b5402bf07b3c832d0ad58ba086010493.jpg[/img]

So, treat Snorri well and be respectful. Your survival in this rough world might depend on it. And so will your dynasty, since the presence of a skald will increase dynasty points. But we will get to that later.

Skal

We’re not done yet, but every step brings us closer to perfection. Your adventure deserves nothing less.

notes.title: Vikings Dynasty – We wish you a great Yule!
notes.content:
[i]Gleðilig jól! Vér biðjum yðr heill ok sæll um jólahátíðina![/i]
(Old Norse, reconstructed)
 
Sæll, Viking! Sæll, Valkyrie!

At Yule, people rejoice at the return of the sun. During this time, sacrifices were made in honour of the gods, especially Odin and Thor.

Fires were lit and alcoholic beverages were served. First, cattle and pigs were sacrificed for the gods, and then the people themselves feasted on large and extensive festive meals.

The Yule tree was decorated with green branches and shrubs to honour life, and on Yule Eve, people gave speeches and wished for good fortune in the coming winter.

At Yule, everyone is joyful and remembers that life and light will conquer darkness. There are a few interesting facts about Yule:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/f79618d1a8d5b59c6c5dc4a61c5ff7287a9760ba.jpg[/img]

The Yule log was a massive piece of wood that was burned in the fireplace. The longer it burned, the more luck it brought. Fun fact: Some families kept the remains of the Yule log to use as protection against lightning strikes the following year!

The Yule goat (a billy goat, often depicted in straw) was originally a mythical creature that tested whether households had prepared enough for the Yule festival. Fun fact: The famous Yule goat of Gävle, a giant straw goat in Sweden, is burned down by pranksters almost every year!

In Yule, gifts were distributed more as a sign of hospitality. They were often practical things like bread, meat or furs. Fun fact: the tradition of giving gifts was later combined with puzzles or fun challenges – ‘presents with a brain teaser’, so to speak, the forerunners of modern secret Santa!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343265/4e62372f3fc42b614a7ff4008f6786e797cedfc7.jpg[/img]

During the cold season, games were held during the Yule festival to strengthen the community. There were competitions such as tug-of-war, ice skating races and even fighting games. Fun fact: losing was often part of the fun – the losers had to serve the banquet for the amusement of the others!

If you don't feel the urge to serve the food during the holidays, we recommend going for a game! We highly recommend the Permafrost demo! Or any other game. Follow the link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197110/Permafrost_Demo/

notes.title: Your Path To Valhalla
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33018175/e9c251cd1814aafb9432bc894a37d9543eabf6d7.png[/img]

Sæl, Viking! Sæl, Valkyrie!

Are you ready to brave the storm-tossed and raging seas? Do the gods smile on you? Do you have the courage, strength and wisdom to become a Jarl?

Then board your dragon boat and set out on an epic journey that will take you to the starting point of the raid that the skalds will sing about for hundreds of winters in the longhouses. Become part of Vikings Dynasty!

Here in the far north, life is hard, rough and relentless. Here life means fighting for survival every day! Whether on a boat in the middle of the stormy sea, surrounded by your loyal, battle-hardened warriors and Valkyries, or on barren earth, where Uller and Skadi make life difficult for you and your clan – you must prove that you are a true leader.

[previewyoutube=4rTsbYjX9Fs;full][/previewyoutube]

Discover an open world full of secrets, dangers and breathtaking beauty!

[b]Build your own kingdom. [/b]Use tools and raw materials to build a mighty village and turn it into a fortress of the north.

[b]Conquer the wilderness.[/b] Hunt wild animals, explore unknown islands and face the terrors of nature.

[b]Rule over land and sea. [/b]Build ships, master fishing and guide your tribe through treacherous waters.

But that's just the beginning. Gain followers, forge alliances and lay the foundation for a dynasty that will outlast the legends. Master the art of agriculture, perfect your shipbuilding skills and lead your settlement to prosperity and power. Rise to become the unchallenged Jarl and reach for the stars – who knows, perhaps Valhalla is written in your destiny.

Will you go down in the annals of history, or will you be blown away in the cold winds of the north? The gods are watching. Now is your time!
